meta.title: 조형 연구소 여름 학교
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (조형 연구소 여름 학교, a two-week summer workshop in basic form and the poster (fictional workshop)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 조형 연구소 여름 학교, a two-week summer workshop in basic form and the poster (fictional workshop)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Constructivist print: cream paper #EFE8D8 with a faint 120-pixel module grid, and three primaries plus black, red #D7263D, blue #1B4F9C, yellow #F2C230 and ink #161616, each printed by multiply a few pixels out of register so overlaps darken like overprinted plates.
rationale.type: Gothic A1 Black, a heavy grotesque, for the words, each letter rising out of its own module; Do Hyeon for dates and small lines.
rationale.motion: One action per beat, in whole modules: shapes roll, drop and slide two modules at a time, bars turn a quarter about a corner, a triangle flips, cards flip in a diagonal wave; everything lands exactly on the grid and the end freezes into a poster whose quarter keeps turning.
rationale.sound: Dark synth at 128 BPM in A dorian, kept minimal: a pad, saw plucks, a rolling saw bass, four-on-the-floor; a woodblock click for every move, claves for the words, a recorded concert bass drum (VCSL, CC0) under the end.
rationale.visuals: All code: shapes are circles, rectangles, triangles and quarter arcs positioned in module units and stepped with eased beat-by-beat paths; every ink is drawn with multiply and its own small offset.
